265: fn select_document_monospace_family(
266:     available: &[String],
267:     candidates: &[&str],
268:     fallback: &str,
269: ) -> SharedString {
270:     candidates
271:         .iter()
272:         .find_map(|candidate| {
273:             available
274:                 .iter()
275:                 .find(|family| family.eq_ignore_ascii_case(candidate))
276:         })
277:         .cloned()
278:         .unwrap_or_else(|| fallback.to_owned())
279:         .into()
280: }
